lemmas.primary_translation: to slim down, for example by following a low-calorie diet or exercising

definitions.text: gjøre seg slank ved hjelp av for eksempel kalorifattig kost eller mosjon
definitions.translation: make oneself slim by means of, for example, a low-calorie diet or exercise

examples.no: jeg slanket meg inn i brudekjolen
examples.en: I slimmed down enough to fit into the wedding dress
